quote.title: New quote
quote.desc: Import a list of laptops and phones: the tool recognises each device, groups identical lines and has the agents look up a buy price and a resale price.

import.drop_desc: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV / TXT, any layout: with or without headers, one row per device, a pivot of models × grades, or a single description column.
import.paste_placeholder: Paste rows copied from Excel, an email or a PDF here, with or without the header row…
import.formats: Columns are recognised from their name (FR, EN, DE, ES, IT, NL) or from what they contain. Quantity and grade written in the description ("3x…", "Grade B") and configs like "i5/16/512" are read too. You can correct any column on the next step.
import.empty: No rows found in this file.

mapping.need_model: Map at least one "Model" or "Description" column.

pricing.sell_hint: Resale prices estimated by the agents
pricing.unpriced_one: {{count}} line without a price: no agent found an offer. Enter a buy price by hand or check the configuration.
pricing.unpriced_other: {{count}} lines without a price: no agent found an offer. Enter a buy price by hand or check the configuration.
pricing.excluded: {{count}} unrecognised devices left out of the quote
pricing.indicative_hint: No listing with this processor: price based on the same model with another configuration.
pricing.on_list: {{count}} of {{total}} line(s) at your list price
pricing.gap_hint: Your price is more than 15% away from the market: check it is still current.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.desc: Quotes saved in this browser. Reopen one to rerun the agents or adjust prices.
quotes.empty_hint: Quotes appear here after "Save" on the Prices step.

reference.title: Reference
reference.desc: The devices the tool can recognise, with every factory configuration checked against the manufacturer spec sheets.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Rules for the buy price. Changes apply immediately to open quotes.
settings.formula_text: Buy price = resale price × (1 − target margin) − refurbishment cost (category, grade). Without a resale price: match the median competitor buyback.
settings.refurb_desc: Parts, labour, logistics and data wiping, per grade. Starting values to adjust.
settings.grade_coef_desc: Coefficient applied to the catalog reference price (phones) when no agent finds a resale price.
settings.agents_desc: The agents call the price server (npm run server, VITE_PRICE_API_URL): buyback and resale sources for phones and laptops, robots.txt respected, one request per second per site, 6 h cache.
settings.server_down: Price server unreachable: run "npm run server" in the project folder.
settings.list_mode_mine: My selling price ("My prices" list) when there is one
settings.list_mode_prudent: Prudent: the lower of my price and the market
settings.list_mode_desc: The buy offer is computed from this resale price. Prudent mode protects the margin when the market has dropped below your list.

add.title: Add a device
add.incomplete: Incomplete configuration: the price will be less precise

sources.buyback_hint: Buyback prices offered by the sites, highest first.
sources.resale_hint: Prices listed by resellers, cheapest first.

prices.title: My selling prices
prices.desc: Your own resale prices by model, configuration and grade. They are the reference on every quote: the buy offer keeps your target margin on the price you actually sell at.
prices.partial_hint: Leave an option empty for the price to apply to every configuration.
prices.import_desc: Excel or CSV, any layout: one row per model with a price column, one price column per grade, or free text ("iPhone 13 128GB grade A – 520 €"). Models are recognised the same way as in quotes.
prices.paste_placeholder: Paste your price list here (from Excel, an email or a PDF)…
prices.need_price: No price column detected: set the column holding your prices to "Price".
prices.imported_other: {{count}} prices imported (existing prices for the same device were updated).
prices.empty_hint: Import your price list or add prices one by one: they show on your quotes and drive the buy price.
